column1: # MicroFi partition table for the 16 MB Lonely Binary ESP32-S3 N16R8.
# Layout sized for a "30-day default offline durability" promise with OTA
#   partition table   4 KB    (this file's compiled form
#   ota_1           2048 KB   application slot B (for OTA rollback)
#   littlefs       ~11.5 MB   FlowFile + Content repositories (durable queue)
# To extend the durability window beyond ~30 days
# CONFIG_MICROFI_SD_OVERFLOW in menuconfig and wire an SD card breakout to
# the configured SPI pins. The SD card extends storage *without* changing
